stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt, who raises him after his parents die and loves him like a son. She keeps setting him up with Mary Jane, and villains from the Scorpion to Morbius drag her into his fights. Before his wedding, a visit from Ben's old friend pushes her to tell Peter about his parents.
stages.whoA: His Aunt May, who raised him and worries over him.
stages.whoB: Her nephew Peter, whom she raised like a son.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle, who helps raise him and once walks him into a science camp as a boy. Peter lets a burglar escape, that burglar kills Ben, and Peter blames himself ever after.
stages.whoA: His late Uncle Ben, killed by a burglar Peter let go.
stages.whoB: His nephew Peter, who blames himself for Ben's death.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ben is May's husband, and together they raise their nephew Peter. Ben is killed by a burglar, leaving May and Peter on their own.
stages.whoA: Her late husband Ben, who helped her raise Peter.
stages.whoB: His wife May, who raises Peter with him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Peter and Mary Jane are a couple again. They watch Asteroid M fall on the news together with their friend Flash.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, the woman he loves, back at his side.
stages.whoB: Peter, the man she loves, back together with her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Aunt May sets Peter up with her friend Anna's niece, and he and Mary Jane fall for each other, though his secret life pushes her toward Harry for a while. She vanishes into a portal during his fight with the Green Goblin. The Mary Jane who comes back learns he is Spider-Man and marries him, then turns out to be a clone, and Peter sets out with Madame Web to find the real one.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane. The love of his life, lost, married as a clone, then sought.
stages.whoB: Peter. She loves him, learns his secret and marries him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary Jane is the niece of May's friend Anna Watson, and May keeps setting her up with Peter. When Mary Jane is lost, May moves in with Anna to help her through it.
stages.whoA: Her friend Anna's niece, whom she wants Peter to date.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt May, her Aunt Anna's friend and matchmaker.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia is Peter's well-off classmate at ESU, and he dates her for a while before Mary Jane. She falls for Spider-Man without knowing it is him and kisses him, but he tells her he cannot have a girlfriend.
stages.whoA: Felicia, a classmate he dates, who loves Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Peter, her classmate and date. She loves his other self.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Once the Kingpin's serum makes her the Black Cat, Felicia turns on him and becomes Spider-Man's partner in the field. They fight side by side against vampires, Hydro-Man and the villains of the Beyonder's world, and share a kiss there.
stages.whoA: The Black Cat, his partner in the field, with feelings for him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, her partner in the field and her old crush.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Harry Osborn, Norman's son, is Peter's friend and roommate. Harry starts dating Mary Jane and later gets engaged to her, but they stay friends until she returns his ring.
stages.whoA: His friend and roommate Harry, Norman Osborn's son.
stages.whoB: Peter, his friend and roommate.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Driven by visions of his lost father, Harry becomes the new Green Goblin and tries to kill Spider-Man, until he is sent to Ravencroft. He escapes to attack Peter's wedding to Mary Jane, until Liz Allan talks him down.
stages.whoA: Harry, now the Green Goblin, out to kill him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he blames for his father's loss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tired of Peter neglecting her, Mary Jane starts dating his friend Harry, and the two get engaged. She calls it off and returns his ring when she realizes she still loves Peter.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, her boyfriend and briefly her fiance.
stages.whoB: Mary Jane, his girlfriend and briefly his fiancee.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: As the Green Goblin, Harry storms Mary Jane's wedding to Peter, grabs her and threatens to blow up the church unless the priest marries her to him instead.
stages.whoA: Harry as the Green Goblin, who tries to force her to marry him.
stages.whoB: Mary Jane, whom he tries to force into marrying him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Morrie Bench is Mary Jane's ex-boyfriend, and as Hydro-Man he stalks her and kidnaps her to win her back. She lures him away from water and he evaporates. Later a clone of him returns and kidnaps her again.
stages.whoA: Her ex-boyfriend Morrie, who stalks her as Hydro-Man.
stages.whoB: His ex-girlfriend, whom he is obsessed with winning back.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn, as the Green Goblin, kidnaps Mary Jane to get at Spider-Man and takes her to the George Washington Bridge. Both of them vanish through a dimensional portal in the fight.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who kidnaps her and drags her into a portal.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man's love, whom he kidnaps and loses with him in a portal.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo draws Mary Jane into his cult, tricking her into believing she is reconnecting with her father, as part of his plan to free Dormammu.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, the sorcerer who draws her into his cult.
stages.whoB: A young woman he draws into his cult to free Dormammu.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary Jane's big break, a role made famous by the actress Miranda Wilson, is a trap set by Mysterio, who has rebuilt the burned Miranda as a cyborg and means to give her Mary Jane's body.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, who lures her into a trap for Miranda Wilson.
stages.whoB: The actress he lures into a trap for Miranda Wilson.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Miles Warren uses his banned cloning work to make a copy of Mary Jane from a drop of Hydro-Man. The unstable clone, the woman Peter married, dissolves.
stages.whoA: Miles Warren, the scientist who cloned her.
stages.whoB: The woman he clones in his undersea lab.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter and Mary Jane ask Dr. Connors to give her away at their wedding. Giant lizards then kidnap them both, and Connors turns into the Lizard again.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, the friend she asks to give her away.
stages.whoB: Mary Jane, who asks him to give her away at her wedding.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary Jane's Aunt Anna asks the Punisher to find her missing niece. When Mary Jane suddenly reappears, he takes her home to Anna.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, who looks for her and brings her home.
stages.whoB: The missing niece he searches for and brings home to her aunt.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Curt Connors is Peter's science teacher at ESU and a friend who helps him with the symbiote and his mutation. Stress or experiments keep turning Connors into the Lizard, and Spider-Man has to stop him and bring him back each time.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, his science teacher, who sometimes becomes the Lizard.
stages.whoB: Peter, his student. As Spider-Man, he cures him of the Lizard.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Debra Whitman is Peter's sharp classmate at ESU, who he calls the little sister he never had. She works on science projects with him and Dr. Connors and comes to his wedding.
stages.whoA: Debra, a brilliant classmate, like a little sister.
stages.whoB: Peter, her classmate and friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie Robertson is an editor at the Daily Bugle and a good friend to Peter who believes Spider-Man is a hero. Spider-Man saves him from Kraven, helps him win back his son and clears his name, and Robbie takes Peter to Russia to look into his parents.
stages.whoA: Robbie, a Bugle editor and good friend.
stages.whoB: Peter, a young friend at the Bugle.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson runs the Daily Bugle and buys Peter's photos, while hating Spider-Man and backing schemes to stop him. He still has a soft spot for Peter, secretly hiring him a lawyer and giving him a van for his wedding.
stages.whoA: His boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Peter, his photographer. Spider-Man, the menace he hates.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Detective Terri Lee teams with Spider-Man to expose Mysterio, then helps him and Blade against Morbius. When Peter is framed, she suspects he is innocent.
stages.whoA: Detective Lee, a police ally.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero she works with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Taina is a terminally ill girl and Spider-Man's biggest fan, and meeting him is her last wish. She helps him recover his memory from Doctor Octopus, and he unmasks for her.
stages.whoA: Taina, his biggest fan, who saves him and learns his name.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, her hero, who shares his secret with her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Madame Web guides Spider-Man with cryptic riddles to prepare him for a great battle to come. He turns away from her when she will not bring Mary Jane back, but she returns to lead him to the Beyonder and then helps him look for Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: Madame Web, his cryptic guide.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the chosen one she prepares.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Mariah Crawford helps Spider-Man cure Kraven, the man she loves. Later she gives Spider-Man a risky serum for his mutation and helps restore him from the Man-Spider.
stages.whoA: Dr. Crawford, a scientist who helps cure him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who helps her cure Kraven.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A serum gives Sergei Kravinoff animal powers and makes him Kraven the Hunter, who hunts Spider-Man and kidnaps Robbie. Mariah's cure ends his madness and he leaves for Africa.
stages.whoA: Kraven, a hunter driven mad by a serum.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, his prey.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cured, Kraven returns to help Spider-Man. He teams with the Punisher to subdue the Man-Spider, and later works with Spider-Man and the Black Cat to save Mariah.
stages.whoA: Kraven, now cured, who helps save him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, now a friend he helps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Believing Jameson's broadcast, the Punisher hunts Spider-Man as a criminal, until Kraven convinces him to help cure the Man-Spider. He then calls off the hunt.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, a vigilante who hunts him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a criminal he hunts, then helps cure.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Searching for Mary Jane for her aunt, the Punisher suspects Peter, until Mary Jane reappears in front of them both.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, who suspects him, then brings Mary Jane home.
stages.whoB: Peter, whom he suspects over Mary Jane's disappearance.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Blade comes to New York to destroy Morbius, while Spider-Man wants to cure him. They clash over it but team up to stop Morbius, and later fight the vampire queen Miriam together.
stages.whoA: Blade, a vampire hunter he works with.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero who wants to save Morbius.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Whistler, Blade's mentor, tells Spider-Man and Terri Lee how he found Blade. Later he helps in the hunt for the vampire queen Miriam.
stages.whoA: Whistler, Blade's mentor and an ally.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero working with Blade.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Michael Morbius, Peter's ESU classmate, steals his mutated blood and is turned into a vampire. Spider-Man fights him while trying to cure him instead of letting Blade destroy him.
stages.whoA: Morbius, a classmate turned vampire.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who fights to cure him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Fighting his hunger with Whistler's serum, Morbius joins Spider-Man, Blade and the Black Cat against the vampire queen Miriam.
stages.whoA: Morbius, now an ally against Miriam.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who now fights beside him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie Brock is a rival reporter who competes with Peter for photos and stories. Jameson fires him for lies about Spider-Man, and Eddie blames the hero.
stages.whoA: Eddie Brock, a rival reporter.
stages.whoB: Peter, a rival at the Bugle.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: When Peter tears off the alien symbiote, it bonds to Eddie and makes him Venom, who knows Peter's secret and wants revenge. Spider-Man rips the symbiote off him with a rocket's roar and sends it into space.
stages.whoA: Venom, the symbiote's new host, out for revenge.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he blames for everything.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: When Eddie refuses to keep serving Dormammu, he teams with Spider-Man and Iron Man against Carnage. He vanishes into a portal dragging Carnage with him to save Dr. Ashley Kafka.
stages.whoA: Eddie, who teams up with him and sacrifices himself.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, an enemy he teams up with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Nick Fury of S.H.I.E.L.D. works to stop the Chameleon alongside Spider-Man. Later Spider-Man goes to Fury for answers about Felicia's father.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, the S.H.I.E.L.D. director.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero S.H.I.E.L.D. works with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Strange and Wong team with Spider-Man to free Mary Jane from Baron Mordo and stop Dormammu.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, a sorcerer who helps save Mary Jane.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he helps against Mordo.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wong fights with twin swords beside Doctor Strange and Spider-Man against Baron Mordo.
stages.whoA: Wong, Doctor Strange's assistant.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he fights beside.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: When Peter is framed for selling government secrets, lawyer Matt Murdock defends him. As Daredevil, he helps Spider-Man clear Peter's name and reveals that Wilson Fisk is the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Matt Murdock, his lawyer, secretly Daredevil.
stages.whoB: Peter, his client. Spider-Man, his partner.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Iron Man teams with Spider-Man and Venom to stop Carnage and Dormammu. Later Spider-Man summons him to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, an ally against Carnage and on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he teams with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: War Machine helps Spider-Man fight Venom and is wounded when the symbiotes steal the accelerator.
stages.whoA: War Machine, who helps him fight Venom.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he helps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Freed from a time loop decades after World War II, Captain America fights the Red Skull beside Spider-Man before being lost in the loop again. Spider-Man later brings him to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
stages.whoA: Captain America, a hero he fights beside.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a modern hero he fights beside.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man races the Kingpin to find the aging Six American Warriors, then fights beside them against the Insidious Six, the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: World War II heroes he helps and fights beside.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the young hero who fights beside them.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In Moscow, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant and leave Spider-Man and Robbie with a ticking bomb. Later she captures Spider-Man, the Kingpin and the Insidious Six.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, a mercenary who leaves him with a bomb.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a target in her way.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Spider-Man frees her from the Red Skull's trap, Silver Sable returns the favor and teams with him against the Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, now an ally against the Red Skull.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who saved her and fights beside her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man summons Mister Fantastic to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team. Reed helps Iron Man restore Curt Connors's mind.
stages.whoA: Mister Fantastic, on his team on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads his team on Battleworld.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man summons the Invisible Woman to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team. She and Storm recharge a lab for them.
stages.whoA: The Invisible Woman, on his team on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads her team on Battleworld.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man summons the Human Torch to the Beyonder's world, where he fights on Spider-Man's team.
stages.whoA: The Human Torch, on his team on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads his team on Battleworld.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man summons the Thing to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team, and leads the rescue when Doom kidnaps him.
stages.whoA: The Thing, on his team on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads the rescue when Doom takes him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Beyonder has Spider-Man lead Spider-Men from other worlds against Spider-Carnage, and Scarlet Spider, Spider-Carnage's own clone brother, joins him.
stages.whoA: Scarlet Spider, another world's Ben Reilly, on his team.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads the Spider-Men.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A rich, high-tech Spider-Man whose identity is public joins Spider-Man's team. When he is too hurt to give chase, Spider-Man goes into his world after Spider-Carnage in his place.
stages.whoA: A cocky armored Spider-Man from another world.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads the team and takes his place.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A six-armed Spider-Man joins Spider-Man's team against Spider-Carnage, but turns into the Man-Spider mid-mission.
stages.whoA: A six-armed Spider-Man who turns into the Man-Spider.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads the Spider-Men.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A Spider-Man wearing Doctor Octopus's arms joins Spider-Man's team against Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: A Spider-Man with Doctor Octopus's arms, on his team.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who leads the Spider-Men.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: An actor who plays Spider-Man joins the team of Spider-Men. Afterward he takes Spider-Man to his world, where Spider-Man is fiction, and there Spider-Man meets his creator Stan Lee.
stages.whoA: An actor who plays him, from a world where he is fiction.
stages.whoB: The real Spider-Man, whom he joins and takes to his world.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Carnage is a Peter Parker from another world, bonded to the Carnage symbiote, who wants to destroy all realities. Spider-Man leads the Spider-Men against him and chases him into another world.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, an evil Peter Parker from another world.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the Peter Parker he despises.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In the armored Spider-Man's world, Ben Parker is still alive. Spider-Man finds this living Uncle Ben and brings him to Spider-Carnage, hoping Ben can reach him.
stages.whoA: A living Uncle Ben from another world.
stages.whoB: Another world's Peter, who asks his help.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Carnage lost his own Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Another world's living Ben reaches him and brings out the real Peter in him, and he leaps through a portal to stop the symbiote.
stages.whoA: A living Uncle Ben, whose words reach the Peter in him.
stages.whoB: A lost Peter Parker he calls back to himself.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ben Parker is the armored Spider-Man's uncle, alive in his world because Ben was never killed.
stages.whoA: His Uncle Ben, alive in his world.
stages.whoB: His nephew Peter, a rich and public Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Carnage and Ben Reilly, the Scarlet Spider, are clones of the same Peter Parker, and Spider-Carnage hates his double. Ben joins the Spider-Men to stop his brother from destroying all realities.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, his clone brother, whom he must stop.
stages.whoB: Ben Reilly, his hated clone brother.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The armored Spider-Man fights Spider-Carnage with the Spider-Men, and Spider-Carnage flees into his world and poses as him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, who flees into his world and poses as him.
stages.whoB: A rich Spider-Man whose life he steals to hide.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The six-armed Spider-Man joins the attack on Spider-Carnage and his gang.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, the evil Peter they hunt.
stages.whoB: A six-armed Spider-Man sent against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Spider-Man with Doctor Octopus's arms joins the fight against Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, the evil Peter they hunt.
stages.whoB: A Spider-Man with metal arms sent against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The actor in a Spider-Man suit joins the team sent to stop Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, the villain he is caught up in fighting.
stages.whoB: An actor in a Spider-Man suit sent against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wilson Fisk is a respected philanthropist who is secretly the Kingpin, Spider-Man's greatest foe. He funds the Spider-Slayers, forms the Insidious Six and has his son frame Peter, until Daredevil reveals his secret to Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, the crime lord behind most of his troubles.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero who keeps ruining his plans.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Otto Octavius once ran a science camp Peter attended. After a lab accident fuses him to his metal arms, Doctor Octopus fights Spider-Man again and again, leading the Insidious Six and even wiping his memory to use him as a partner in crime.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, his old teacher, now a villain.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero who keeps stopping him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn, Harry's father and Oscorp's ruthless owner, hires Spencer Smythe to destroy Spider-Man. He later becomes the Green Goblin, learns Peter's identity and kidnaps Mary Jane, and both vanish into a portal.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, Harry's father, who becomes the Green Goblin.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he hunts as the Green Goblin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Hobgoblin is a mercenary on a glider who plays Norman Osborn and the Kingpin against each other and kidnaps Harry. Spider-Man finally unmasks him as Jason Macendale, Felicia's fiance.
stages.whoA: The Hobgoblin, a goblin for hire.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who keeps foiling him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cletus Kasady bonds with a symbiote and becomes Carnage, stealing life energy for Dormammu. Spider-Man teams with Iron Man and Venom to stop him.
stages.whoA: Carnage, a killer bonded to a symbiote.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he wants to kill.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo draws Mary Jane into his cult to free Dormammu, and Spider-Man teams with Doctor Strange to stop him. Mordo later returns Venom's symbiote and helps create Carnage.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, a sorcerer serving Dormammu.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stands in his way.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dormammu tries to reach Earth through Baron Mordo, Venom and Carnage. Spider-Man reverses the portal and sends him back.
stages.whoA: Dormammu, a demon lord he sends back.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who seals him away.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe blames Spider-Man for his father's loss and builds Spider-Slayers to kill him, even becoming a cyborg Spider-Slayer himself. Spider-Man helps him recover his frozen father, and on the Beyonder's world Alistair ends up aiding the heroes.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who builds Spider-Slayers to kill him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he blames for his father's loss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn hires Spencer Smythe to build a Spider-Slayer, and Spencer seems to die fighting Spider-Man when Oscorp explodes. Later Spider-Man helps Alistair take back his frozen body.
stages.whoA: Spencer Smythe, the inventor of the Spider-Slayer.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the target of his Spider-Slayer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson pays to have private eye Mac Gargan turned into the Scorpion to stop Spider-Man. He fights Spider-Man many times, with the Insidious Six and on his own, and kidnaps Aunt May before Peter's wedding.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, a private eye mutated to stop him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he was made to beat.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Quentin Beck uses special effects to frame Spider-Man for crimes, until Spider-Man and Terri Lee expose him. He returns with the Insidious Six and later with a trap for Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, an effects wizard who frames him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero who exposes him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Shocker blasts Spider-Man with vibration gauntlets for the Kingpin and later fights him with the Insidious Six.
stages.whoA: The Shocker, one of the Kingpin's thugs.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he fights for the Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Adrian Toomes, an aging inventor, becomes the Vulture and drains Spider-Man's youth, but is left with his mutation. He later joins the Insidious Six against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who steals his youth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whose youth he steals.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Rhino charges Spider-Man in his armored suit for the Kingpin and goes to prison rather than talk. He returns with the Insidious Six.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, a thug in an armored suit.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he charges for the Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon, a master of disguise, tries to kill two diplomats until Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. catch him. He returns with the Insidious Six, helps frame Peter, and finally betrays the Kingpin for his stepfather, the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, a spy who can wear any face.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who keeps catching him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hydro-Man, Mary Jane's ex-boyfriend, goes after her, and Spider-Man fights him to save her. Later a clone of him kidnaps Mary Jane from their honeymoon.
stages.whoA: Hydro-Man, Mary Jane's water-powered ex.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stands between him and Mary Jane.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Silvermane is an aging crime boss at war with the Kingpin who uses the Tablet of Time to grow young. Later, as a baby, he has Alistair try to take Spider-Man's youth.
stages.whoA: Silvermane, an old crime boss chasing youth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero in his way.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hammerhead does Silvermane's dirty work and fights Spider-Man, then goes over to the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, a mob enforcer.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tombstone, Robbie's childhood friend turned mob enforcer, beats Spider-Man and kidnaps Dr. Connors. Spider-Man later jails him for using Robbie's son and stops his escape with Richard Fisk.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, a mob enforcer from Robbie's past.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who puts him behind bars.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Herbert Landon offers mutants a cure while secretly planning to destroy them, and later becomes the Kingpin's chief scientist. He turns Alistair into a cyborg and Felicia into the Black Cat.
stages.whoA: Dr. Landon, the Kingpin's mad scientist.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero who foils his work.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Richard Fisk gives Peter a job at Fisktronics, then frames him for selling government secrets. Spider-Man and Daredevil clear Peter's name and send Richard to prison.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, the Kingpin's son, who frames him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the employee he frames.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Miles Warren clones Hydro-Man and Mary Jane in an undersea lab, and Peter loses the clone he married. Warren keeps a scrap of Spider-Man's suit.
stages.whoA: Miles Warren, the scientist who cloned Mary Jane.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whose suit he keeps a scrap of.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Miriam, the vampire queen, comes to New York to make more vampires, and Spider-Man, Blade, Morbius and the Black Cat stop her.
stages.whoA: Miriam, the vampire queen, Blade's mother.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stops her plan.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Freed from a vortex by his son and stepson, the Red Skull traps both Spider-Man and the Kingpin's side and turns his son into Electro. On the Beyonder's world he rules an empire until Spider-Man's team defeats him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, a Nazi from World War II.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero who defeats him twice.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Rheinholdt Kragov, a Moscow police chief and the Red Skull's son, threatens Peter in Moscow. The doomsday device turns him into Electro, and Spider-Man and the Six stop him.
stages.whoA: Electro, the Red Skull's son.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stops him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom takes over a realm and kidnaps the Thing, then absorbs the Beyonder's power. Spider-Man's team defeats him.
stages.whoA: Doctor Doom, ruler of a realm on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whose team defeats him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father. When Norman vanishes into a portal, Harry believes he is dead, and the Green Goblin calls out to him from limbo, pushing him to become the new Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: His son Harry, whom he pushes into becoming the Goblin.
stages.whoB: His father Norman, whose footsteps he follows as the Goblin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spencer Smythe is Alistair's father, who builds the Spider-Slayer partly to get his paralyzed son a hoverchair. Alistair believes him dead, then learns the Kingpin has kept him frozen, takes back his body and works to revive him.
stages.whoA: His father Spencer, whom he works to bring back.
stages.whoB: His son Alistair, who fights to revive him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Richard Fisk is the Kingpin's son and runs Fisktronics. He frames Peter for his father and goes to prison, and from there the Kingpin helps him frame Robbie Robertson.
stages.whoA: His son Richard, who runs Fisktronics.
stages.whoB: His father, the Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Miriam is Blade's mother, who left him at an orphanage after his vampire father abandoned them. Blade is horrified to learn she has become the vampire queen, and he hunts her across Europe.
stages.whoA: His mother, now the vampire queen he hunts.
stages.whoB: Her son Blade, who hunts her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Kragov is the Red Skull's son. He frees his father from the vortex, and the Skull's doomsday device turns him into Electro, after which he betrays his own family.
stages.whoA: His son Kragov, whom he turns into Electro.
stages.whoB: His father, the Red Skull, whom he frees and betrays.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon is the Red Skull's stepson, who learned his disguises from him as a boy. Decades later he betrays the Kingpin to free his stepfather from the vortex.
stages.whoA: His stepson, the Chameleon, who frees him.
stages.whoB: His stepfather, the Red Skull.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon and Kragov are stepbrothers, sons of the Red Skull. They free their father together, but Kragov betrays them both once he becomes Electro.
stages.whoA: His stepbrother Kragov, who betrays him as Electro.
stages.whoB: His stepbrother, the Chameleon.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Sergei Kravinoff and Dr. Mariah Crawford fall in love in Africa, and the serum she gives to save his life turns him into Kraven. She cures him and they leave together, and when the same serum later makes her the feral Calypso, he becomes Kraven again to save her.
stages.whoA: Mariah, the woman he loves.
stages.whoB: Sergei, the man she loves and once cured.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mister Fantastic and the Invisible Woman are husband and wife and lead the Fantastic Four together. Spider-Man brings them to the Beyonder's world.
stages.whoA: His wife, Sue.
stages.whoB: Her husband, Reed.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Human Torch is the Invisible Woman's brother, and they fight together in the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoA: Her brother Johnny.
stages.whoB: His sister Sue.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Human Torch is Mister Fantastic's teammate in the Fantastic Four and his wife's brother.
stages.whoA: Johnny, his teammate and brother-in-law.
stages.whoB: Reed, his team's leader and brother-in-law.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thing is Mister Fantastic's teammate in the Fantastic Four, and Reed has long failed to cure him. When Doom kidnaps the Thing, Doom gives him a watch that turns him human, something Reed could never do.
stages.whoA: Ben, his teammate, whom he has never been able to cure.
stages.whoB: Reed, his teammate, who has never cured him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thing is the Invisible Woman's teammate in the Fantastic Four, and she joins the rescue when Doom kidnaps him.
stages.whoA: Ben, her teammate in the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoB: Sue, his teammate in the Fantastic Four.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Human Torch and the Thing are teammates in the Fantastic Four, and Johnny joins the rescue when Doom kidnaps Ben.
stages.whoA: Ben, his teammate in the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoB: Johnny, his teammate in the Fantastic Four.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Michael Morbius starts dating Felicia after saving her from a mugging. An experiment turns him into a vampire, and he kidnaps her.
stages.whoA: Michael, her boyfriend, who becomes a vampire.
stages.whoB: Felicia, his girlfriend.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: As the Black Cat, Felicia cannot bring herself to destroy Morbius, still hoping to cure him. Once he controls his hunger, they hunt the vampire queen Miriam together, and she leaves to travel with him.
stages.whoA: Morbius, the man she still loves.
stages.whoB: Felicia, who never gives up on him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia gets engaged to Jason Macendale, whom Peter distrusts. Jason is unmasked as the Hobgoblin and arrested, leaving her devastated.
stages.whoA: Jason, her fiance, unmasked as the Hobgoblin.
stages.whoB: Felicia, his fiancee.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Terri Lee teams with Blade and Spider-Man against Morbius and falls for Blade, but they decide a relationship would be too dangerous. They share a last kiss before he leaves to hunt Miriam.
stages.whoA: Blade, the vampire hunter she falls for.
stages.whoB: Terri, the detective who falls for him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie Robertson and Lonnie Lincoln are childhood friends, until Lonnie takes the fall for a robbery they both took part in.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, his childhood friend.
stages.whoB: Robbie, his childhood friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Lonnie returns as the enforcer Tombstone and pulls Robbie's son Randy into crime, until Robbie and Spider-Man win him back. From prison, Tombstone and Richard Fisk get Robbie framed.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, his old friend, now out for revenge.
stages.whoB: Robbie, the friend he wants to ruin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Whistler finds Blade as an outcast orphan and raises and trains him as a vampire hunter. He later joins Blade's hunt for the vampire queen Miriam.
stages.whoA: Whistler, who raised and trained him.
stages.whoB: Blade, the boy he raised and trained.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: War Machine is Tony Stark's friend, and both fight the symbiotes around Stark Enterprises' accelerator.
stages.whoA: War Machine, his friend.
stages.whoB: Tony Stark, his friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Debra Whitman, an ESU science student, becomes Dr. Connors's assistant at his new neogenics lab.
stages.whoA: Debra, his student and lab assistant.
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors, her teacher and boss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Michael Morbius is Debra's lab partner, and she has a crush on him, but he gently turns her down for Felicia. After he disappears, she leads the search to find him.
stages.whoA: Michael, her lab partner and crush.
stages.whoB: Debra, his lab partner.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wong is Doctor Strange's assistant, and he fights beside Strange against Baron Mordo.
stages.whoA: Wong, his assistant.
stages.whoB: Doctor Strange, the sorcerer he serves.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow, secretly the Destroyer of the Six, is an old friend of Ben's who visits May before Peter's wedding.
stages.whoA: Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's.
stages.whoB: May, the wife of their old friend Ben.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In 1946, Ben's friend Keene Marlow, the Destroyer of the Six, gives Ben his costume and ring to keep after a tragedy.
stages.whoA: His friend Keene, who trusts him with his costume.
stages.whoB: Ben, a friend who keeps the Destroyer's costume.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Cat teams with Blade against Morbius and the vampire queen Miriam, and they track Miriam across Europe together.
stages.whoA: Blade, a vampire hunter she hunts with.
stages.whoB: The Black Cat, a partner in the hunt.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia goes to Whistler for a way to stop Morbius, and he arms her. He joins her and Blade in the hunt for Miriam.
stages.whoA: Whistler, who arms her against Morbius.
stages.whoB: The Black Cat, whom he arms.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Cat and Spider-Man first confront Kraven, then work with him to save Mariah from her feral change.
stages.whoA: Kraven, who works with her to save Mariah.
stages.whoB: The Black Cat, who helps save Mariah.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Terri Lee hunts Morbius alongside Spider-Man and the Black Cat.
stages.whoA: Detective Lee, an ally in the hunt.
stages.whoB: The Black Cat, an ally in the hunt.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Blade comes to New York to destroy Morbius, but Spider-Man talks him into trying to cure him instead, and together they stop Morbius.
stages.whoA: Morbius, a vampire he hunts.
stages.whoB: Blade, the hunter sent to destroy him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: With his hunger held back by a serum, Morbius joins Blade against the vampire queen Miriam, and they battle her across Europe.
stages.whoA: Morbius, now an ally against Miriam.
stages.whoB: Blade, now his partner against Miriam.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Whistler arms the Black Cat against Morbius, but later nurses him when he is weakened, and his serum helps Morbius fight his hunger.
stages.whoA: Whistler, who nurses him and helps hold back his hunger.
stages.whoB: Morbius, a vampire he helps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Kraven stops the Punisher from killing the Man-Spider and convinces him that Spider-Man is innocent. They team up to subdue him so he can be cured.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, whom he talks into helping Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Kraven, who convinces him to help.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie Brock reluctantly teams with Iron Man and Spider-Man to stop Carnage and save Dr. Ashley Kafka.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, an ally against Carnage.
stages.whoB: Venom, an ally against Carnage.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: War Machine helps Spider-Man fight Venom at Stark Enterprises.
stages.whoA: War Machine, who fights him beside Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Venom, whom he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson employs Eddie as a reporter, then fires him over his lies about Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Jameson, the boss who fires him.
stages.whoB: Eddie Brock, a reporter he fires.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson is Robbie's boss at the Daily Bugle, and Robbie often defends Spider-Man to him. When Robbie is framed and jailed, Jameson works with Spider-Man to clear his name.
stages.whoA: Robbie, his editor, whom he clears.
stages.whoB: Jameson, his boss at the Bugle.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Nick Fury enlists Jameson's help to stop the Chameleon from killing two diplomats.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, who enlists his help.
stages.whoB: Jameson, whom he enlists.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: When Peter is framed, Jameson secretly hires lawyer Matt Murdock to defend him.
stages.whoA: Matt Murdock, the lawyer he hires for Peter.
stages.whoB: Jameson, who hires him for Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In World War II, the Six American Warriors are made with a version of the super soldier formula and fight beside Captain America against the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: The Six, heroes who fought beside him.
stages.whoB: Captain America, the hero they fought beside.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Silver Sable frees Spider-Man and the Six American Warriors from the Red Skull's trap.
stages.whoA: The Six, whom she frees from the Red Skull.
stages.whoB: Silver Sable, who frees them.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Captain America and Iron Man guard the White House together against Bastion's Prime Sentinels as Magneto's blackout ends.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who guards the White House with him.
stages.whoB: Captain America, who guards the White House with him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man brings both to the Beyonder's world, where they fight on the same team.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, a teammate on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Captain America, a teammate on Battleworld.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In World War II, Sergeant Nick Fury, fighting the Nazis, meets Captain America and shakes his hand.
stages.whoA: Sergeant Fury, a soldier he meets in the war.
stages.whoB: Captain America, whom he meets in the war.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Mister Fantastic and Iron Man use alien technology to wake Curt Connors's mind inside the Lizard, and Connors joins the heroes.
stages.whoA: Mister Fantastic, who restores his mind.
stages.whoB: Connors, whose mind he restores.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Iron Man and Mister Fantastic wake Curt Connors's mind inside the Lizard, and he joins their team.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who restores his mind.
stages.whoB: Connors, whose mind he restores.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Iron Man and Mister Fantastic team up on the Beyonder's world to restore Curt Connors's mind.
stages.whoA: Mister Fantastic, who works with him on Connors.
stages.whoB: Iron Man, who works with him on Connors.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn is deep in debt to the Kingpin, who forces him to go after Spider-Man and later to build weapons. Norman even hires the Hobgoblin to kill him, and as the Green Goblin he turns on him.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, who owes him and works under his threats.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who holds his debts over him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn hires the Hobgoblin to kill the Kingpin. The Hobgoblin then works for the Kingpin and double-crosses him to take his empire, until the Kingpin wins it back.
stages.whoA: The Hobgoblin, a hired goblin who betrays him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, a crime lord he tries to topple.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Hobgoblin later returns to work for the Kingpin, until he is unmasked and arrested.
stages.whoA: The Hobgoblin, back on his payroll.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his employer again.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin breaks Doctor Octopus out of prison to lead the Insidious Six, and later takes him on to steal the super soldier formula and bring him Felicia.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, who leads his Insidious Six.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who frees and hires him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin funds Alistair Smythe's Spider-Slayers, claiming Spider-Man killed his father, and keeps him working until he succeeds.
stages.whoA: Alistair, the genius who builds his Spider-Slayers.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who funds his revenge.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Blaming Alistair for Richard's arrest, the Kingpin has him turned into a cyborg Spider-Slayer. Alistair breaks free, learns the Kingpin has kept his father frozen, and turns on him.
stages.whoA: Alistair, the servant he made a cyborg.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who lied to him about his father.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin secretly keeps Spencer Smythe's body frozen to keep his son Alistair under control.
stages.whoA: Spencer Smythe, whose frozen body he hides.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who keeps him frozen.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin frees the Scorpion to join the Insidious Six, and later reunites them to hunt the Red Skull's doomsday device.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, one of his Insidious Six.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who hires him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mysterio joins the Kingpin's Insidious Six, and later builds a robot Venom with the Kingpin's money.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, one of his Insidious Six.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who funds him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Shocker works for the Kingpin, blasting Spider-Man, joining the Insidious Six and helping Herbert Landon kidnap Morbius.
stages.whoA: The Shocker, one of his hired guns.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his employer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Rhino works for the Kingpin and goes to prison rather than talk. The Kingpin breaks him out for the Insidious Six.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, a loyal thug.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, whom he refuses to betray.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Vulture joins the Kingpin's reunited Insidious Six in place of Mysterio to hunt a doomsday weapon.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, a new member of his Six.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who leads the Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin breaks the Chameleon out for the Insidious Six and later uses him to steal John Hardesky from S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, his master of disguise.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his employer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Freed by the Six to hunt the Red Skull's doomsday device, the Chameleon betrays the Kingpin to free his stepfather, the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, who betrays him for the Red Skull.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, whom he betrays.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Silvermane leads the crime lords in a war against the Kingpin, and they fight over the Tablet of Time, trading kidnapped family members.
stages.whoA: Silvermane, a rival crime boss.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his rival crime boss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Fired by Silvermane, Hammerhead goes over to the Kingpin and kidnaps Silvermane's daughter Alisa for him.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, who defects to him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his new boss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Working for Silvermane, Tombstone kidnaps the Kingpin's wife Vanessa to win the Tablet of Time.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, who kidnaps his wife.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, whose wife he kidnaps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Herbert Landon becomes the Kingpin's chief scientist, making Alistair a cyborg and Felicia the Black Cat, and stays at his side as the Six hunt the doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Dr. Landon, his chief scientist.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, his employer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin kidnaps Felicia's father for the super soldier formula and has the serum turn Felicia into the Black Cat to carry out his crimes. She turns on him to team with Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Black Cat, the woman he makes and loses.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who made her the Black Cat.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Daredevil helps Spider-Man clear Peter's name, tells him Fisk is the Kingpin, and faces Fisk himself.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who exposes him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, the crime lord he exposes.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin hunts the Red Skull's doomsday device, but the Skull's son tricks and traps him, and the freed Red Skull traps him again.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, who traps him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, a rival for the doomsday device.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Kragov poses as the Red Skull and captures the Kingpin and his Six, then becomes Electro.
stages.whoA: Kragov, who poses as the Red Skull to trap him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, whom he traps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Silver Sable's Wild Pack captures the Kingpin, the Insidious Six and Spider-Man in Moscow.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, who captures him.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, whom she captures.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin's Insidious Six steal the Six American Warriors' rings and fight them for the last one.
stages.whoA: The Six, old heroes whose rings he steals.
stages.whoB: The Kingpin, who steals their rings.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus kidnaps Felicia to force her mother to fund him. Later he blackmails her mother and brings Felicia to the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, who kidnaps her twice.
stages.whoB: Felicia, his hostage.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, the Scorpion among them, against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, leader of the Six.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, one of his Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, Mysterio among them, against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, leader of the Six.
stages.whoB: Mysterio, one of his Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, the Shocker among them, against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, leader of the Six.
stages.whoB: The Shocker, one of his Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, the Rhino among them, against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, leader of the Six.
stages.whoB: The Rhino, one of his Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, the Chameleon among them, against Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, leader of the Six.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, one of his Six.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: When Doctor Octopus brainwashes Spider-Man, Taina turns the tables by crashing a cab into him and capturing him with his own Octobot.
stages.whoA: Taina, the girl who beats him.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, the villain she beats.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom takes over Doctor Octopus's realm.
stages.whoA: Doctor Doom, who takes his realm.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, whose realm he takes.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Octopus and Alistair join forces with the Red Skull against Spider-Man's team.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, an ally on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, an ally on Battleworld.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn builds the Hobgoblin's gear and hires him to kill the Kingpin, then fires him after he fails.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, who arms and hires him.
stages.whoB: The Hobgoblin, the killer he hires.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Hobgoblin turns on Norman and kidnaps Harry. Later, as the Green Goblin, Norman sees him as an impostor and defeats him.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who calls him an impostor.
stages.whoB: The Hobgoblin, who betrayed him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Hobgoblin kidnaps Harry Osborn to strike at his father, until Spider-Man brings him home.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, his hostage.
stages.whoB: The Hobgoblin, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Hobgoblin blackmails Herbert Landon over his plot against mutants, and the accident he causes turns Landon into a lizard-like mutant.
stages.whoA: Landon, a scientist he blackmails.
stages.whoB: The Hobgoblin, who blackmails him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman Osborn hires Spencer Smythe to build a Spider-Slayer, promising a hoverchair for his son Alistair in return.
stages.whoA: Spencer Smythe, the inventor he hires.
stages.whoB: Norman Osborn, who hires him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman gets Alistair a hoverchair in return for his father's work, but Alistair holds him responsible for his father's death and targets him with his Spider-Slayers.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who blames him for his father's death.
stages.whoB: Norman Osborn, whom he blames.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman tries to take over Adrian Toomes's company, and Toomes becomes the Vulture to destroy him.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who wants revenge on him.
stages.whoB: Norman Osborn, who tried to take his company.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Green Goblin kidnaps Oscorp's stockholders, Jameson among them, and takes him hostage.
stages.whoA: Jameson, one of his hostages.
stages.whoB: The Green Goblin, who takes him hostage.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe arms Harry to attack Peter's wedding as the Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: Alistair, who arms him for the wedding attack.
stages.whoB: Harry, whom he arms.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cletus Kasady is Eddie's former cellmate, and he becomes Carnage with the offspring of Eddie's symbiote. They fight over Spider-Man, and in the end Eddie drags Carnage into a portal to save Dr. Kafka.
stages.whoA: Carnage, his former cellmate and symbiote spawn.
stages.whoB: Venom, his former cellmate and rival.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo returns Eddie's symbiote in exchange for his service to Dormammu and orders him to steal a machine from Stark Enterprises.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, who returns his symbiote.
stages.whoB: Venom, his servant.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie refuses to keep serving Mordo and turns against him with Spider-Man and Iron Man.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, whom he defies.
stages.whoB: Venom, who defies him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dormammu brings the symbiote back to Earth and Eddie serves him in return.
stages.whoA: Dormammu, the demon who brought back his symbiote.
stages.whoB: Venom, his servant.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie refuses Dormammu's plan, and he and his allies send the demon back through the portal.
stages.whoA: Dormammu, the demon he turns on.
stages.whoB: Venom, who turns on him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo helps create Carnage and sends him to steal life energy for Dormammu.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, who helps create him.
stages.whoB: Carnage, the monster he helps make.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dormammu gives Carnage the power to drain life force and uses him to reach Earth, until a reversed portal pulls Carnage in.
stages.whoA: Dormammu, his master.
stages.whoB: Carnage, his servant.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Iron Man teams with Spider-Man and Venom to stop Carnage and Dormammu.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who helps stop him.
stages.whoB: Carnage, whom he helps stop.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Carnage waits for Terri Lee at her home and later drains her life force, until Spider-Man stops Dormammu's plan and it returns.
stages.whoA: Detective Lee, whose life force he drains.
stages.whoB: Carnage, who drains her life force.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo serves Dormammu and works to free him from the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoA: Dormammu, the master he serves.
stages.whoB: Baron Mordo, his servant.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Strange and Wong team with Spider-Man to stop Baron Mordo from freeing Dormammu.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, who foils him.
stages.whoB: Baron Mordo, the sorcerer he stops.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wong fights Baron Mordo with twin swords beside Doctor Strange.
stages.whoA: Wong, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Baron Mordo, whom he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Strange works with Spider-Man to stop Dormammu from being freed.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, who keeps him out.
stages.whoB: Dormammu, the demon he keeps out.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wong fights beside Doctor Strange to stop Dormammu's servants from freeing him.
stages.whoA: Wong, Strange's assistant.
stages.whoB: Dormammu, the demon he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Kingpin's orders, Herbert Landon turns Alistair into a cyborg Spider-Slayer.
stages.whoA: Landon, who turns him into a cyborg.
stages.whoB: Alistair, whom he turns into a cyborg.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair becomes Silvermane's top scientist in the hope of reviving his father, and kidnaps the Black Cat to get the DNA Silvermane needs.
stages.whoA: Silvermane, his new employer.
stages.whoB: Alistair, his top scientist.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Working for Silvermane, Alistair holds the Black Cat hostage to make Spider-Man bring him the Scorpion or the Vulture.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who holds her hostage.
stages.whoB: The Black Cat, his hostage.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Alistair serves the Red Skull before going over to the heroes.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, whom he serves on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: Alistair, his servant on Battleworld.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After his lab is wrecked, Miles Warren calls Alistair to have Silvermane's men repair it.
stages.whoA: Miles Warren, a scientist he helps.
stages.whoB: Alistair, who arranges his repairs.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair blames Jameson, among others, for his father's loss and tries to kill him with his Spider-Slayers.
stages.whoA: Jameson, a man he tries to kill.
stages.whoB: Alistair, who tries to kill him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson hires private eye Mac Gargan to find out how Peter gets his photos, then pays for the experiment that makes him the Scorpion.
stages.whoA: Jameson, who hires him and makes him the Scorpion.
stages.whoB: Mac Gargan, the private eye he hires.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mutating beyond control, the Scorpion believes Jameson tricked him, attacks him and kidnaps him.
stages.whoA: Jameson, the man he blames for his mutation.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, who turns on him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Scorpion kidnaps Aunt May before Peter's wedding, until Spider-Man rescues her.
stages.whoA: May Parker, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, who kidnaps her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Seeking a cure, the Scorpion kidnaps the Vulture, thinking him smart enough to undo his mutation.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, whom he kidnaps for a cure.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Terri Lee teams with Peter to expose Mysterio's framing of Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Detective Lee, who helps expose him.
stages.whoB: Mysterio, whom she exposes.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Shocker helps Herbert Landon kidnap Morbius for the Kingpin, and Morbius escapes.
stages.whoA: Morbius, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: The Shocker, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Shocker helps Herbert Landon kidnap Morbius for the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Landon, whom he helps kidnap Morbius.
stages.whoB: The Shocker, his hired muscle.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Herbert Landon has Morbius kidnapped to study his neogenics and reverts him to a vampire. Morbius later drains his plasma.
stages.whoA: Landon, who kidnaps him.
stages.whoB: Morbius, who drains his plasma.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Herbert Landon recreates the super soldier serum and uses it to turn Felicia into the Black Cat.
stages.whoA: Landon, who turns her into the Black Cat.
stages.whoB: Felicia, whom he turns into the Black Cat.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Vulture swaps ages with the infant Silvermane, making himself young again and Silvermane old.
stages.whoA: Silvermane, whose youth he takes.
stages.whoB: The Vulture, who takes his youth.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Vulture briefly drains Debra Whitman's youth, turning her old until it wears off.
stages.whoA: Debra Whitman, whose youth he drains.
stages.whoB: The Vulture, who drains her youth.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Nick Fury's S.H.I.E.L.D. catches the Chameleon after his plot against two diplomats, and holds him until he escapes to free John Hardesky for the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, whose agents catch him.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, whom he jails.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Daredevil helps Spider-Man expose the Chameleon's part in framing Peter.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who helps bring him in.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, whom he helps catch.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon helps Richard Fisk frame Peter for selling secrets, until both are taken into custody.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, whom he helps frame Peter.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, his partner in the frame.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Kraven mistakes Robbie for Mariah's other man and kidnaps him, until Spider-Man saves him.
stages.whoA: Robbie, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: Kraven, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Morbius kidnaps Aunt May along with Felicia.
stages.whoA: May Parker, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: Morbius, who kidnaps her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Terri Lee helps Spider-Man and Blade stop Morbius, and later hunts him with Spider-Man and the Black Cat.
stages.whoA: Detective Lee, who hunts him.
stages.whoB: Morbius, a vampire she hunts.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The vampire queen Miriam finds Morbius through a psychic link to learn how he became a vampire. He fights her beside Blade and the Black Cat.
stages.whoA: Miriam, the vampire queen he fights.
stages.whoB: Morbius, whose secret she wants.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Cat fights the vampire queen Miriam in New York and tracks her across Europe.
stages.whoA: The Black Cat, who hunts her.
stages.whoB: Miriam, the vampire queen she hunts.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Whistler joins Blade's hunt for the vampire queen Miriam.
stages.whoA: Whistler, Blade's mentor, who hunts her.
stages.whoB: Miriam, the vampire queen he hunts.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Cat helps Spider-Man chase Hydro-Man's clone after it kidnaps Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: The Black Cat, who chases him.
stages.whoB: Hydro-Man, whom she chases.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Miles Warren clones Hydro-Man in his undersea lab, and the clone kidnaps Mary Jane before breaking down and dying.
stages.whoA: Miles Warren, who clones him.
stages.whoB: The Hydro-Man clone he made.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hammerhead does Silvermane's dirty work until Silvermane fires him for failing, and he goes over to the Kingpin.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, his enforcer, until he fires him.
stages.whoB: Silvermane, his boss, until he is fired.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tombstone becomes Silvermane's new enforcer and kidnaps Vanessa Fisk and Dr. Connors to win the Tablet of Time for him.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, his new enforcer.
stages.whoB: Silvermane, his boss.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tombstone kidnaps Dr. Connors for Silvermane.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In prison, Tombstone helps Richard Fisk in fights, and Richard has his father frame Robbie so they can take revenge. They break out together, until Spider-Man sends them back.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, his partner in prison.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, his partner in prison.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Daredevil helps Spider-Man expose Richard's frame of Peter and send him to prison.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who exposes him.
stages.whoB: Richard Fisk, whom he exposes.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: From prison, Richard Fisk and Tombstone have Robbie framed, until Spider-Man and Jameson clear his name.
stages.whoA: Robbie, the man he frames.
stages.whoB: Richard Fisk, who frames him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In World War II, Captain America and Wolverine raid the Red Skull's base to rescue a scientist and fight him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, his Nazi enemy.
stages.whoB: Captain America, the Allies' champion.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull and Captain America are trapped together in a vortex during the war. Freed decades later, they fight again, and are lost in the vortex together once more.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, his old enemy, trapped in time with him.
stages.whoB: Captain America, his old enemy, trapped in time with him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull traps Silver Sable along with Spider-Man, and she turns against him.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, who fights him.
stages.whoB: The Red Skull, who traps her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Six American Warriors fight the Red Skull in World War II, and again when he is freed decades later.
stages.whoA: The Six, old enemies from the war.
stages.whoB: The Red Skull, their wartime enemy.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Iron Man fights on the team that topples the Red Skull's empire.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, one of the heroes who topple him.
stages.whoB: The Red Skull, whose empire he topples.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, the Black Cat fights on the team that topples the Red Skull's empire.
stages.whoA: The Black Cat, one of the heroes who topple him.
stages.whoB: The Red Skull, whose empire she topples.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Silver Sable and Spider-Man track down Kragov and the Red Skull, and fight Electro.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Electro, whom she fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: As Electro, Kragov takes over S.H.I.E.L.D. and New York's power.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, whose S.H.I.E.L.D. he takes over.
stages.whoB: Electro, who takes over S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man and the Six American Warriors stop Electro.
stages.whoA: The Six, who help stop him.
stages.whoB: Electro, whom they stop.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In Moscow, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant and leave Robbie and Spider-Man with a ticking bomb.
stages.whoA: Silver Sable, who leaves him with a bomb.
stages.whoB: Robbie, a reporter in her way.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Doctor Doom kidnaps the Thing and gives him a watch that turns him human, until the heroes rescue him.
stages.whoA: The Thing, whom he kidnaps.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom kidnaps the Thing and manages to cure him, something Mister Fantastic never could, then fights the heroes with the Beyonder's power.
stages.whoA: Mister Fantastic, his old rival.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, his old rival.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, the Invisible Woman joins the heroes who rescue the Thing and defeat Doctor Doom.
stages.whoA: The Invisible Woman, who helps defeat him.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, whom she helps defeat.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, the Human Torch joins the heroes who rescue the Thing and defeat Doctor Doom.
stages.whoA: The Human Torch, who helps defeat him.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, whom he helps defeat.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Iron Man fights Doctor Doom with Spider-Man's team.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, whom he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Captain America fights Doctor Doom with Spider-Man's team.
stages.whoA: Captain America, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Doctor Doom, whom he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Shane is Naoko's ten-year-old son, and she raises him alone on Counter-Earth. Peter comes to live with them after he saves Shane from a Machine Man.
stages.whoA: Her young son Shane.
stages.whoB: His mother, Dr. Naoko Yamada-Jones.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: After Peter saves her son, Dr. Naoko Yamada-Jones lets him stay in her home. She comes to hate Spider-Man after her clinic is wrecked in his fight with Venom and Carnage, never knowing he is Peter.
stages.whoA: Naoko, the doctor he lodges with, who hates Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Peter, her lodger. Spider-Man, a hero she has come to hate.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Shane looks up to Peter, the young man staying in his home, without knowing he is Spider-Man. He hates it when Peter and his mother argue.
stages.whoA: Shane, the boy he lodges with, who looks up to him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the lodger he looks up to.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Blamed for the loss of John Jameson's ship, Spider-Man follows him to Counter-Earth to bring him home. He finds John alive and leading the rebels against the High Evolutionary, and joins the fight beside him.
stages.whoA: John Jameson, the astronaut he came to rescue.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who came to bring him home and stayed to fight.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Karen O'Malley, the rebels' second in command, fights beside Spider-Man. When the High Evolutionary's Machine Men kidnap her, Spider-Man and X-51 rescue her.
stages.whoA: Karen, a rebel leader he fights beside.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero who rescues her.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Daniel Bromley helps the Bestials trap Spider-Man in the hope of finding his lost brother. The two then escape Castle Wundagore together.
stages.whoA: Daniel, a rebel who betrays him, then escapes with him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he betrays, then escapes with.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Git Hoskins steals a device from Sir Ram's lab that carries a bomb, and Spider-Man and the rebels race to recover it. Spider-Man learns how Sir Ram's experiments shaped Git.
stages.whoA: Git, a mute rebel he helps.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a fellow rebel.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man saves the Machine Man X-51, who then refuses to hurt innocents and joins the rebels. Together they rescue Karen O'Malley.
stages.whoA: X-51, a Machine Man who joins him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who saved him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Counter-Earth's heroic Goblin first mistakes Spider-Man for a villain, then teams with him to save Naoko. He later works out that Spider-Man is Peter Parker and fights beside him.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, a hero who learns his secret.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a fellow hero.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man teams with Counter-Earth's heroic Vulture to stop Sir Ram from kidnapping humans.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, a hero he teams with.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he teams with.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary rules Counter-Earth through his Bestials, keeping humans beneath them. Spider-Man fights him alongside the rebels.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, ruler of Counter-Earth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a rebel against his rule.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Lord Tyger, a Knight of Wundagore, fights Spider-Man for the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: Lord Tyger, a Knight of Wundagore.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a rebel he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram, a Knight of Wundagore, experiments on humans and hires the Hunter to kill Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Sir Ram, the Knight who wants him dead.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he wants dead.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Lady Vermin, a rat Bestial and Knight of Wundagore, clashes with Spider-Man and keeps trying to win him over.
stages.whoA: Lady Vermin, a Bestial with a crush on him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the enemy she has a crush on.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Hunter is hired to kill Spider-Man and finds evidence that he is Peter Parker. Spider-Man beats him and warns him to stay away from him and the rebels.
stages.whoA: The Hunter, a mercenary hired to kill him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the target he fails to kill.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Breaking into the High Evolutionary's base, Spider-Man runs into Counter-Earth's Electro, an electric eel Bestial on guard there.
stages.whoA: Electro, an eel Bestial on guard.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, an intruder he fights.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man fails to stop Venom and Carnage from hijacking John Jameson's ship and follows them to Counter-Earth. When the Bestials separate Eddie from his symbiote, Spider-Man reluctantly wears it to recover it and returns it before Eddie dies.
stages.whoA: Venom, his old enemy, whom he still saves.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, his enemy, who saves his life.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man fails to stop Carnage and Venom from hijacking John Jameson's ship and fights them on Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Carnage, his symbiote enemy.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, his enemy.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Synoptic, a mass of ancient symbiotes, directs Venom and Carnage in their plan to take over Counter-Earth, and Spider-Man fights to stop it.
stages.whoA: The Synoptic, the symbiote mass behind Venom and Carnage.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stands against its plan.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Karen O'Malley is John Jameson's second in command in the Rebellion, and the two have feelings for each other.
stages.whoA: Karen, his second in command, who he cares for.
stages.whoB: John, the rebels' leader, who she cares for.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: John Jameson leads the human rebels against the High Evolutionary, whose experiments leave him able to turn into the Man-Wolf.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, the ruler he rebels against.
stages.whoB: John Jameson, leader of the rebels.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram experiments on John Jameson, making him turn into the Man-Wolf when angered unless an inhibitor chip holds it back.
stages.whoA: Sir Ram, who made him the Man-Wolf.
stages.whoB: John Jameson, his test subject.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Venom and Carnage hijack John Jameson's ship to Counter-Earth, and it crashes there.
stages.whoA: Venom, who hijacked his ship.
stages.whoB: John Jameson, whose ship he hijacked.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Carnage and Venom hijack John Jameson's ship to Counter-Earth, and it crashes there.
stages.whoA: Carnage, who hijacked his ship.
stages.whoB: John Jameson, whose ship he hijacked.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Karen O'Malley is the High Evolutionary's granddaughter. He experimented on her before she was born, giving her great strength, and only learns who she is after his Machine Men kidnap her.
stages.whoA: Her grandfather, the tyrant she fights.
stages.whoB: His granddaughter Karen, a rebel.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: X-51 teams with Spider-Man to rescue Karen from the High Evolutionary's Machine Men.
stages.whoA: X-51, who helps rescue her.
stages.whoB: Karen, whom he rescues.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary takes Daniel Bromley's family, and Daniel joins the rebels for revenge. Promised his lost brother, he helps the Bestials, then has to flee the High Evolutionary's wrath.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, who took his family.
stages.whoB: Daniel Bromley, a rebel.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram's experiments shaped Git Hoskins as a child and made him an outcast, and Git holds a grudge against him. He steals a device from Sir Ram's lab that turns out to carry a bomb.
stages.whoA: Sir Ram, who experimented on him as a child.
stages.whoB: Git, a boy he experimented on.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: X-51 is one of the High Evolutionary's Machine Men until he gains a conscience, refuses to hurt innocents and joins the rebels.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, the master he betrays.
stages.whoB: X-51, a Machine Man who betrays him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Goblin joins Spider-Man and the rebels against the High Evolutionary's plans.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, a tyrant he fights.
stages.whoB: The Goblin, a hero against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Venom and Carnage kidnap Naoko, and the Goblin teams with Spider-Man to save her and stop them.
stages.whoA: Venom, a villain he fights.
stages.whoB: The Goblin, a hero who fights him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Carnage and Venom kidnap Naoko, and the Goblin teams with Spider-Man to save her and stop them.
stages.whoA: Carnage, a villain he fights.
stages.whoB: The Goblin, a hero who fights him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Venom and Carnage kidnap Dr. Naoko Yamada-Jones, until Spider-Man and the Goblin save her.
stages.whoA: Venom, who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: Naoko, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
