stages.text: Carnage and Venom kidnap Dr. Naoko Yamada-Jones, until Spider-Man and the Goblin save her.
stages.whoA: Carnage, who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: Naoko, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Counter-Earth's Vulture teams with Spider-Man to stop Sir Ram from kidnapping humans for his experiments.
stages.whoA: Sir Ram, the Knight he stops.
stages.whoB: The Vulture, who stops him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Lord Tyger, a tiger Bestial and one of the High Evolutionary's first New Men, serves him as a Knight of Wundagore.
stages.whoA: Lord Tyger, one of his Knights.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram serves the High Evolutionary as a Knight of Wundagore and convinces him Spider-Man must be dealt with.
stages.whoA: Sir Ram, one of his Knights.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Lady Vermin serves the High Evolutionary as a Knight of Wundagore.
stages.whoA: Lady Vermin, one of his Knights.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, her master.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Counter-Earth's Electro guards the High Evolutionary's base.
stages.whoA: Electro, a guard at his base.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary hires the Hunter to capture or kill Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Hunter, a mercenary he hires.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his employer.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram hires the Hunter to kill Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Hunter, the assassin he hires.
stages.whoB: Sir Ram, who hires him.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Venom and Carnage, working for the Synoptic, plot with the High Evolutionary to unleash millions of symbiotes on Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Venom, an ally in his plan.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his ally.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Carnage and Venom, working for the Synoptic, plot with the High Evolutionary to unleash millions of symbiotes on Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Carnage, an ally in his plan.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, his ally.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Synoptic plans to team up with the High Evolutionary before unleashing its symbiotes on Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: The Synoptic, a symbiote mass he plots with.
stages.whoB: The High Evolutionary, its ally.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Venom and Carnage work together, hijacking John Jameson's ship and serving the Synoptic on Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Carnage, his partner in crime.
stages.whoB: Venom, his partner in crime.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Synoptic directs Venom in its plan to spread symbiotes across Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Venom, its servant.
stages.whoB: The Synoptic, his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Synoptic directs Carnage in its plan to spread symbiotes across Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Carnage, its servant.
stages.whoB: The Synoptic, his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Betty Brant is J. Jonah Jameson's secretary at the Daily Bugle. When she helps Spider-Man escape Henry Smythe's robot, Jameson sends her out.
stages.whoA: Her boss, J. Jonah Jameson.
stages.whoB: Betty, his secretary.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Betty drives out after Peter to Doctor Octopus's hidden lab and is captured there, until Spider-Man frees them both.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, who captures her.
stages.whoB: Betty Brant, whom he captures.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino captures Betty at his wax museum and traps her and Spider-Man above hot wax.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who traps her in his wax museum.
stages.whoB: Betty Brant, his captive.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: When Henry Smythe's robot catches Spider-Man, Betty frees him by pulling the plug on its controls.
stages.whoA: Henry Smythe, whose robot she unplugs.
stages.whoB: Betty, who ruins his robot's catch.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Henry Smythe builds a Spider-Slayer robot to capture Spider-Man for a fee from Jameson, who grows excited once it starts the hunt.
stages.whoA: Henry Smythe, the inventor he pays.
stages.whoB: Jameson, who pays for his robot.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Mysterio frames Spider-Man for a robbery, then offers Jameson a deal to defeat and expose him for a large sum.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, who offers to catch Spider-Man for him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, who takes his deal.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Stillwell creates the Scorpion on Jameson's behalf to catch Spider-Man, but the Scorpion turns on Jameson. He breaks out of prison twice to go after him again.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, made for him, now hunting him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, the man he blames.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Green Goblin puts a spell on Jameson to use him as a medium for summoning demons.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who uses him as a medium.
stages.whoB: Jameson, his medium.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Vulture captures Jameson at his clock tower hideout and learns about a military rocket from him, until Spider-Man rescues him.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who holds him captive.
stages.whoB: Jameson, his captive.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Electro robs Jameson's house to frame Spider-Man. Spider-Man catches him and leaves him hanging outside Jameson's window.
stages.whoA: Electro, who robs his house.
stages.whoB: Jameson, whose house he robs.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Sandman steals the Goliath Diamond and demands a ransom from Jameson, who pays him with a rock.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, who demands his ransom.
stages.whoB: Jameson, who cheats him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson scoffs at Dr. Noah Boddy's claim of invisibility, so Boddy frames him for robberies and attacks him at the Bugle.
stages.whoA: Dr. Noah Boddy, who targets him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, who scoffed at him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson turned down Miss Trubble's story, and she conjures Greek monsters for revenge on him.
stages.whoA: Miss Trubble, who wants revenge on him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, whom she blames.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Kingpin kidnaps Jameson to stop his exposé on a fake medicine ring, until Spider-Man rescues him.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who kidnaps him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Posing as a visiting Prime Minister, the master of disguise gets Jameson to raise money for him. Later Jameson sets a trap with the police to catch the art thief.
stages.whoA: A master of disguise who cons him.
stages.whoB: Jameson, a man he cons.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Noah Boddy breaks the Green Goblin out of prison to get revenge on Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, a villain he frees.
stages.whoB: Dr. Noah Boddy, who frees him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Noah Boddy breaks the Vulture out of prison to get revenge on Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, a villain he frees.
stages.whoB: Dr. Noah Boddy, who frees him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Noah Boddy breaks Electro out of prison to get revenge on Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Electro, a villain he frees.
stages.whoB: Dr. Noah Boddy, who frees him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: When the Radiation Specialist takes over the city's minds, Captain Stacy resists and helps Spider-Man beat him.
stages.whoA: The Radiation Specialist, a mind controller he resists.
stages.whoB: Captain Stacy, who resists him.
